scenes.text: You can spot an AI deck in *two* seconds
scenes.say: [knowing, slightly amused] You can spot an AI deck... in two seconds.
[casual] Read the titles. Market overview. Customer insights. Competitive landscape. Recommendations.
[beat] [emphatic] Topics. Every one. But consultants? They write the answer.

scenes.caption: Made in Occam
scenes.say: [confident] In Occam, the deck opens with the answer. We win on speed of setup, not on price.
[conversational] And every point under it is a claim. [pointed] Read them alone... and you've got the story.

scenes.loop: Two seconds. That's all *your boss* reads.
scenes.say: [upbeat] Topics name the slide. Answers make the case. [playful] Two seconds... that's all your boss reads.
